questions_and_answers.assessment_review: Eduqas official SAMs Component 2 Questions 17–18 and the current specification verify a 15-mark single-poem task followed by a 25-mark comparison, assessing AO1/AO2. The official sample uses A Gull and Considering the Snail. Waiting and Departure are original practice poems created for this project; all questions and model answers are original. Short marks are quick-revision allocations, not examination formats. Suggested timing follows the official 20/40-minute advice; no invented poet context is taught.
